provenance.method: Retained 1x inputs; fresh index for every cold run; separate clone of that round's completed cold cache for every write case; serial alternating fresh processes; fixed CPU affinity; default Node heap; filesystem caches left warm; strict worker exits; full rebuild column proof after each CLI update. Harness additions only, no production implementation changes.
provenance.samplingDecision: Stopped at 42 completed runs after user challenged unnecessary 60-run matrix. Cold and repeated-query controls have 3 samples per host/backend. CLI edits have 2 samples; Workbench edits have 2 except stable-size package edit, which has 1. Actual sample counts and all ranges are retained.
provenance.poIsolation: Original PO mtime restored before and after subsequent write runs after inspecting and excluding the timestamp-isolation attempt. All accepted writes begin without rebuilding the join. Each timed stage follows explicit main-thread GC.
